name: Key Club (high school service club)
what_you_do: You do service, leadership and fundraising through a student-led club at your school. If your school has no club, you can start one.
who_can_apply: Any high school student who wants to serve and lead. Clubs are set up in high schools or equivalent schools. Members are expected to do at least 50 hours of service a year.
pay_detail: No pay. Members pay nominal dues (amount not listed on the pages read).
deadline_text: Join your school's club or start one. No cycle stated.
how_to_apply: Use the Find a Key Club tool on keyclub.org, or follow the Start a Key Club steps if your school has none.
notes: Dues and local rules vary by club; dues amount not stated on the pages read. Key Club International phone: 800-549-2647.
